renderings.bsb: since we have now been justified

elsewhere.note: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is…
When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified…
Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations…
that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
